# Defensible answers from difficult health data.

::: {.lead-statement}
I turn messy operational and survey data into decisions you can defend — and I rescue analyses that have gone sideways before they reach a reviewer or a board.
:::

::: {.credibility}
PhD in nursing science (2026) and a registered nurse with emergency and intensive-care experience, now a quantitative methodologist. I publish peer-reviewed methods work and I have spent years inside the systems this data comes from, so the analysis answers the question you actually have.
:::
